title: Abbas Ja Rahe Hai
body:
bacche tadap rahe hai
abbas jaa rahe hai
har bibi ro rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai
apne rida ko zainab
haye hasrat se dekhti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jaa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe huwe labon par
bachon zaban na phero
mashk o alam ko dekho
kuch dayr mein yahan tak
khud nehr aa rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun mashk tum ne dedi
ghazi ko shahzaadi
ay ranj o gham ki aadi
khush kyun hai ay sakina
kuch dayr ki khushi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhukne lagi kamar hai
abbas ka safar hai
sheh mar na jaaye darr hai
aafat gham o alam ki
sarwar pe gir padi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek shor e al-atash hai
phaila hua faza mein
masroof hai dua mein
kya sog karbalaa mein
umeed aakhri hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon mein shor e matam
hone laga hai paiham
har aankh hogayi nam
shaam e ghariban daaman
phailaati jaa rahi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke baazuon ko
chooma tha jab ali ne
lamhaat e zindagi mein
baazu bandhenge mere
zainab samajh gayi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan azmi wo
manzar na likh sakunga
bas itna keh sakunga
kehte thay shaahe waala
kam meri zindagi hai
abbas jaa rahe hai...
author: Rehaan Azmi
